title: Machine-client login answers the documented SuccessfulResponse with a Bearer JWT that then authenticates a restaurant-scoped call

source.note: The page's request is {clientId, clientSecret, userAccessType: TOAST_MACHINE_CLIENT} and its response {"@class": ".SuccessfulResponse", token: {tokenType Bearer, scope null, expiresIn, accessToken, idToken null, refreshToken null}, status SUCCESS}; expiresIn is 'the number of seconds that the authentication token is valid' (the example shows 19168, which the page presents as an example and not a rule, so the case asserts an integer). accessToken is 'A JSON Web Token (JWT) string' (toast-authentication-api.yaml), asserted as three base64url segments. The second step sends the minted token with Toast-Restaurant-External-ID, the documented pairing for every restaurant-scoped call.
